description: Point the data and admin tools (list_documents, get_document, list_users, list_roles, cron_list_jobs, storage_list_objects…) at a Rebase Cloud project's production backend, by its id, slug or name — any project the signed-in account can reach, linked here or not. Calls go through the console's Studio proxy with the CLI's own login (`rebase cloud access-token`); the control plane checks the person's access and attaches the project's service key on its side, so no key is needed or shown. Reads work; tools that change data stay refused against it unless REBASE_MCP_ALLOW_REMOTE_WRITES is set. rebase_project_switch goes back to another project.

project.description: The project's id, slug or name, from rebase_cloud_projects_list

name: rebase_project_use_cloud
